## User barrier or workflow problem

Describe who is affected and the task they cannot complete or reliably audit.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the observable result, including a concrete HTML, CSS, component or CLI example.

## Specification and evidence

Link relevant primary-source guidance. Distinguish an automated failure from a heuristic or a check that requires manual testing.

## Alternatives and limitations

Describe existing workarounds, potential false positives and any compatibility considerations.
